doubts: The page gives one loop with three car parks where the walk can start: Taylors Mistake (main way, the page's usual start), Godley Head car park, and Breeze Col car park. Each start is recorded as its own loop way, walked round from that start in the same direction as the main way. The page does not say clockwise or anticlockwise, so direction is null. Taylors Mistake car park is F2, the only road end on Taylors Mistake Road; the text says the car park is at the end of Taylors Mistake Road. Godley Head car park and Breeze Col car park are on Summit Road, where several road ends exist (F1, F3 to F7), and the text does not tie either car park to one of them, so their refs are null. Only the main way has DOC's time and distance; the 3 hr loop and 9.3 km figures are DOC's whole-loop figures. The Pilgrims Way leg and the return leg each have their own time and distance in the text (1 hr 45 min / 4.1 km and 1 hr 45 min / 5.6 km), but as they are legs of the main way they are not recorded as ways. Scott's Cabin is a side trip from Taylor Battery and is recorded as a side trip and as not on route. Godley Head Campsite is not stated to be on the way, so it is not a hut. Pilgrims Way and the walk through Rotten Row are described only as the main way's first leg.
